text:
So guys here are a few details I noticed on my tenth watch of King Lacy's first music video since 2023 (totally not freaking out):

From around 0:21 we can already see the idea and message in the video and song. It's not a difficult guess to say that "the feeling" here is isolation. The accompanying lyrics like "the devil is working hard to keep me alone" indicate some level of loneliness as well. (Steve did say that the album started coming around better after his last breakup, so this could be a reference to the last relationship also heavily intoned in lyrics like "we're down to the wire" and the verses after) 


I also noticed a few fun things from 1:07. Firstly Steve is with his guitar and if you remember lyrics from Nice Shoes, he said that "you could be sad abd not notice" and all he needs is "my guitar and serotonin" so I'm guessing that this particular part of the song is a very sad and heartfelt part for him (it is also the part that he released to the public around last week, so there has to be something in there he wants us the fans to find). What I did find is that despite the leading lyrics to the chorus saying "there's just one thing", the chorus actually asks two questions. Now I had to do some extracting and rewatching to get that but Steve isn't just asking "Am I your baby?" ( a question one would most likely ask for validation in a relationship) but he also asks "Am I a bad thing?" at around 1:37 (a question asking for validation of one's entire existence, which makes it more obvious that the relationship was or, if not real, is definitely one of heavy codependency (Cody Freestyle reference?). And this little detail makes the song a lot more relatable for me, because I have kinda been there before. 

I was already lost in Steve's eyes at 2:02 before I noticed the next detail. I don't know how it skipped my mind before but the haircut Steve has here is the exact same one that Malcolm Todd had in his Chest Pain (I Love) video. Now I can't say for sure that that is the direct inspiration for Steve's new style (which he already showed us since around January this year in some spam posts on TikTok) but seeing as they're appearing more and more together AND Steve was also credited with background vocals and the instrumental for the outro of Do That Again, the last song from the same titled Malcolm Todd album, I can't be blamed for holding out hope that Malcolm might be on another track on Steve's soon coming album.

Still on this part of the video, the fire/ring light behind Steve. As he sings the lyrics might be an indication of the headache the unanswered questions are giving him. "Is it gonna heal?" "Why you gotta test my patience?" etc.

3:27 This is my favorite part of the video by far, reminiscent of Steve's style in the Playground MV, but also evidence of the restless, vulnerable and deeply troubled  state of Steve's mind.

4:21 the final shot is a direct reference to the album cover, showing that Steve is most likely coming to terms with his aloneness and is therefore putting himself front and center of his thoughts.


Thank you for reading (if you did) and while I'm fairly sure that there is a lot more to find in the video, and also very aware of the possiblity that I may be wrong in some of my observations, I would very much love to hear from  everyone and see what y'all might have noticed or interpreted as well. Whatever happens I will be excitedly waiting for the full album to drop. Much love!!

text:
Every day seems to get a little harder, a little more heavy on my heart. I feel as fragile as a balloon, almost as if it just takes a little something to push me over the edge. But I know I’m not the type to give up, that’s something I am sure of. As much hurt I am going through right now, the heaviest weight I’ve had to go through, I know it will amount to something, I will amount to something.
	I’m not sure what switch flipped in me, but I just knew one day that this is what I want. People ask me, forever…? Yes, I say with no hesitation. I’m not even sure how to put it into words, but I just know. This is my person. I know, because I showed vulnerability, I yelled, I cried. “That is toxic” “He wasn’t the one for you, if he is causing you pain” that’s the thing. The parts of me that I hide from the rest of the world, the parts people judge, I was able to show. I was able to express myself. Parts of me that I can’t accept in myself, that I hate. Every time I expressed them, they became easier to handle, to love even.
	We live in a society that tells us that when we express these emotions with the people we love it is wrong for us, for the relationship, I disagree. With every struggle, sadness, anger, I learn, I improve. What a blessing it is to be so close to people that we can cry, show weakness. Why would that ever be wrong?
	No matter how many times people tell me to give up on this, it does not phase me. I know this is my person, I will wait however long it takes until I can be with him. I love his laugh, his smile, his face, his passions, his kindness, his forgiveness. But also his vulnerability, his anger, his sensitivity. To me these traits I love just as much, because to me they are not flaws at all. They are the parts of himself no one else sees, unless you are close to him, how special is that? I am very in love with him, as I was before too. The only difference was I made many mistakes, I have regrets.
	But I would give anything just to be friends again, just to talk to him. I messed up due to my own fears, how wrong I was. Being so scared to lose myself, that I did anyway. Love is taking risks, I am taking more risks than ever with very little reward. But I know I love him. No, not the idea of him, not the memories, not the old relationship. Although I hold those very dear to me. It’s him. Even when I wasn’t sure of myself, of my own emotions, I was always sure about him. That is why I never let him go. I may be delusional to still keep at this, I know. But even if there is something in me, as little or big as it might be, that might think I still have a chance, I will risk it. 
	I am fully aware of toxic relationships, and how their time has been done. This is not that. Far from it. We had a lot of ups and downs, for a moment it was toxic. But I only learn from all of the hurt, never dwell in it. I never cared what people said about him, his looks, his flaws, I always took their words into account. But never let them decide for me, I still don’t. I love to listen to people, what they have to say. Learning new things from one another. But I use that to go forward and make my own decisions. My dad and I had a conversation that still sticks out to me.
	He said, “could you see yourself spending the rest of your life with him, no matter what. I didn’t hesitate, “yes.” “Then go for it, you are young, you have so much time ahead of you, you have nothing to lose.” I don’t…nothing. My possibilities are endless. If this is not meant for me, and it really is the end, I’ve dealt with loss, and overcame it, I can do it again. But until I 100% know that it is, I’m not giving up, I am giving it everything I got with no regrets. 
	When I talk to others and I have a great conversation with them, I think Marcus would love to talk to them. When I have a bad experience or conversation with someone I think Marcus would dislike this person, and I could talk to him about it.
	I am very picky about the people I decide to love and give everything to, for me it only takes a bit to know if I want this person in my life, but it takes time to know if I need them. I knew I needed him, and I know I still do. I wouldn’t want to do life with anyone else, ever. I can’t imagine it, I don’t want to. He is the only one I want to love. He makes me a better person, I talk to everyone about him, how great of a person he is. It is funny how love brings out parts of you that would usually never come out. But maybe that is a good thing. Maybe it’s good to let out emotions you keep hidden.
	Yes I have hobbies, things I love, people I love. But in a way I don't think the two intertwine each other, but rather influence each other instead. Push one forwards or backwards in a way. Even when things go wrong, or we don’t talk, it just influences me to become a better person, to do better. Never to go backwards, because I know what will come will come. But when you know you love something you put all the effort into it that you can, give it everything you got, exactly what I am going through with basketball. Even if the world is against me, I will not give up, it is not in me to.
	“What will you do if you finally do get back together, and it’s not the same/not what you want?” First off it will never be the same, people change in the slightest ways, every day, good or bad, notice or don’t. The decision you have to make is if you are willing to love unconditionally, despite the change. If you don't even bother, it will only cause more pain. But I am willing to love him, through everything, nothing can change that. Now for the question, if it’s not something I want, well then it’s not, then all of this will stop, for good. But why would I opt out on the chance that it is?
	That even if there is the slightest chance we will go through everything together, grow old, travel, have a future, I am willing to risk being judged, being embarrassed, looking dumb, in order to have everything I have ever wanted. Wouldn’t you too?
